difficultyAxis: Floor of the scale: a single entity with three attributes, one story and two scenarios, no relationships and no validation rules. Anything that fails here fails at the simplest possible shape.
rationale: Establishes the lower bound of the graded sweep. One entity, no foreign keys, no declared validation, one CRUD verb (create) plus one read. If the generator cannot emit a compiling service for this shape, every higher tier is uninterpretable.
